## What's new

Threadnote 5.5.0 can still find unchanged memories by meaning while it refreshes recall after an edit.

### Recall during updates

After a memory edit, recall can still find unchanged memories by meaning while their vectors remain compatible. New and edited memories stay searchable by keyword while their vectors update.

Strong matches by meaning now have a place in searches with many keyword matches. For example, a search for “slow startup” can find a memory about “launch latency” even when many other memories contain the query words.

Small updates can reuse unchanged vectors and embed the affected memories. Background refresh stages its index writes before it takes the account write lock. Other memory writes can proceed during preparation.

### Index status and storage

Run `threadnote index status` or `threadnote doctor --dry-run` to see the vector read state, waiting count, and last refresh. The refresh details include the build type, reused and embedded chunks, and elapsed time.

Threadnote automatically compacts the recall vector database when enough space is reclaimable and enough disk space is available.

Code graph search can use the previous vector index while new vectors are pending. It keeps matches for symbols that still qualify and have the same fingerprint in the current snapshot.

### Pull request workflows

Pull request watches can show failing checks and test paths in their notifications. Workflow closeout can recover the exact merge evidence for a pull request whose head advanced after phase delivery.

A reviewed phase can still deliver after its comparison base advances when Threadnote verifies that the reviewed changes are identical.

### Upgrade and telemetry

Keep your existing recall vector database when you upgrade. Threadnote can scan all memories once if the previous vector generation lacks a compatible access record.

If you opt in to telemetry, the new recall fields report read state counts and refresh durations in buckets. Run `threadnote telemetry status` to check your consent. If renewal is required, review the preview from `threadnote telemetry enable` before you run `threadnote telemetry enable --apply`.
